Card Q&A.q: If an opponent's Digimon is attacking and another effect digivolves one of my Digimon into this card, does that meet the "if during an attack" condition in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Dorumon] or [Ryudamon] from your hand to your empty breeding area without paying the cost. Then, if during an attack, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Security A.+1＞ and gets +5000 DP.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] This Digimon doesn't activate [Security] effects on Option cards it checks.
